manifest.name: dsh-tool-round-limited-target
manifest.description: 给 DSH 的 /goal 加轮数：写成的轮数就是最多自动执行的轮数，用完自动标为 blocked（round-limit）。
manifest.author: Fireawa

scripts.check: node selftest.mjs && node verify-live.mjs && node mutate.mjs

meta.title: 限轮目标（/goal 加轮数）
meta.description: /goal 5 整理文档 —— 只有轮数写在最前面才会设上限；其余写法按官方 /goal 语义（不设上限）。第 N 轮做完自动标为 blocked（round-limit）。clear/pause/resume/edit 全部保留，另加 /goal rounds <n>。

bundle.text:
# dsh-tool-round-limited-target — 给 /goal 加一个轮数
#
#   /goal 5 整理文档        最多自动跑 5 轮，用完自动停（blocked/round-limit）
#   /goal 整理文档          官方行为：不设轮数上限，一直做到目标完成
#   /goal 整理文档 5        同上，5 只是目标文本的一部分
#   /goal rounds 8          只改上限，保留已跑进度
#
# 接管方式：内置 /goal 挂在 agent preset 的作用域里，命令合并顺序是
# global → 作用域链（远→近），最近的胜出。所以本插件在 agent 作用域注册同名
# goal 就压过它，不用改任何全局包；同时保留内置 definitionId，客户端照旧显示
# 「目标」+ 目标图标，/目标 也能直接敲。
#
# 下面是可选配置，值就是默认值。

- insert:
    - id: round-limited-target
      name: 'dsh-tool-round-limited-target'
      config:
        commandName: goal            # 主命令名（/^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$/u）
        aliasCommandName: target     # 全局别名，接管失败时的退路；'' 关闭
        shadowGoalPerAgent: true     # false = 退回内置 /goal 行为
        trailingRounds: false        # 只认「/goal 5 目标」；末尾数字按官方语义算目标文本
        toolName: round_limited_goal # 给模型用的工具
        defaultRounds: 3             # 仅当 requireExplicitRounds=false 时才用它兜底
        maxAllowedRounds: 500        # 超过直接报错，不夹断
        requireDirectHuman: true     # 工具沿用内置 create_goal 的权限策略
        requireExplicitRounds: true  # 没有显式轮数就拒绝建目标（防止模型在普通对话里误触发）

给 DSH 的 `/goal` 加一个轮数上限：**写在最前面的数字就是最多自动执行的轮数，用完自动停**。

```bash
/goal 3 整理文档      # 最多 3 轮
```

```bash
/goal 3 整理文档        # 最多 3 轮
```

- 轮数写在**最前面**才是上限，`轮` / `次` / `rounds` 可省：`/goal 3轮 整理文档` 等价。
- 写在末尾不算：`/goal 整理文档 3` 里的 3 属于目标文本，按官方语义不设上限。
- 子命令同内置 `/goal`：`rounds <n>` 只改上限、`edit [轮数] 目标` 改目标、`pause` / `resume` / `clear`，不带参数查看状态。

轮数用完，目标自动变成 `blocked`（`code=round-limit`），不会多跑。要接着做：

```bash
/goal rounds 8      # 先提高上限
/goal resume        # 再恢复
```

要求：Node.js 20+，且已装好 DSH。

跟随 `main`（会随仓库最新提交变化）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Fireawa/dsh-tool-round-limited-target.git
```

锁定版本（推荐，行为可预期）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Fireawa/dsh-tool-round-limited-target#v1.0.3
```

也可以 Web → **Plugins** → 添加插件 → 粘贴上面的地址（或本地路径）。装完**重启 `dsh web`**。
本地开发用 `link:` 指向 checkout 即可。
`round_limited_goal(target, rounds?, replace?)`：给模型用的自然语言入口。`target="3 整理文档"` 或 `rounds=3` 就是 3 轮；**没有显式轮数时直接拒绝**，避免模型在普通对话里凭空建出一个限轮目标。

`cordis.patch.yml` 可改，括号内是默认值：

```yaml
commandName: goal            # 主命令名
aliasCommandName: target     # 别名，'' 关闭
shadowGoalPerAgent: true     # false = 退回内置 /goal
trailingRounds: false        # 只认「3 目标」；末尾数字按官方语义算目标文本

```bash
node selftest.mjs      # 136 项，离线
node verify-live.mjs   # 20 项，需要本机 DSH（没有会跳过）
node mutate.mjs        # 变异测试
npm run check          # 全跑

实现只有 `index.js` + `lib/{parse,command,tool,config}.js`，零依赖。

Give DSH's `/goal` a round cap: **the number written first is how many rounds it may run automatically — and it stops by itself once they are used up.**

```bash
/goal 3 clean up the docs     # at most 3 rounds
```

- The number must come **first** to set a cap; `rounds` / `轮` / `次` are optional (`/goal 3 rounds clean up the docs` is equivalent).
- A trailing number does not count: in `/goal clean up the docs 3` the 3 is objective text, so the official semantics apply (no cap).
- Subcommands match the built-in `/goal`: `rounds <n>` raises the cap only, `edit [rounds] <objective>` changes the objective, `pause` / `resume` / `clear`, and no argument shows status.

Once the rounds are used up the goal is automatically marked `blocked` (`code=round-limit`) and never runs an extra round. To continue:

```bash
/goal rounds 8      # raise the cap first
/goal resume        # then resume
```

Requires Node.js 20+ and a working DSH installation.

Track `main` (moves with the latest commit):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Fireawa/dsh-tool-round-limited-target.git
```

Pin a version (recommended, predictable behaviour):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Fireawa/dsh-tool-round-limited-target#v1.0.3
```

You can also use Web → **Plugins** → add plugin → paste the URL above (or a local path). **Restart `dsh web`** afterwards.
For local development just `link:` the checkout.

`round_limited_goal(target, rounds?, replace?)`: the natural-language entry point for the model — `target="3 clean up the docs"` or `rounds=3` means 3 rounds. **A call without an explicit round count is refused**, so the model cannot conjure a capped goal out of an ordinary request.

`cordis.patch.yml` is editable; values in the comments are the defaults:

```yaml
commandName: goal            # primary command name
aliasCommandName: target     # alias, '' disables it
shadowGoalPerAgent: true     # false = fall back to the built-in /goal
trailingRounds: false        # only "3 <objective>"; trailing digits stay objective text

```bash
node selftest.mjs      # 136 checks, offline
node verify-live.mjs   # 20 checks, needs a local DSH (skips otherwise)
node mutate.mjs        # mutation testing
npm run check          # all of the above

The implementation is just `index.js` + `lib/{parse,command,tool,config}.js`, with zero dependencies.
